time_s: Seconds from the first retained observation; recorded timestamps, no temporal interpolation
source_index: Index in the original untrimmed demonstration
pred_actions_normalized: [evaluated_observations, 10, 7], native model output; action_pose inverse in normalization.json for the first six channels
plot_protocol: Only the first action of each chunk is plotted, using recorded observations; no cumulative integration or smoothing
gripper_accuracy: Fraction of model sign decisions (threshold 0) matching the held +/-1 target; plots and CSV retain continuous predictions
